cohort_definitions.full: Every released question, with missing final options scored incorrect
cohort_definitions.active: Any actual post-initial allocation assigns at least one independent response; includes later technical failures
cohort_definitions.disputed: Valid shared initial answer choices with at least two distinct legal options
cohort_definitions.discovery: Initially gold-absent disputed questions; a valid later medical-answer round first contains the gold choice
cohort_definitions.candidate_loss: Initially gold-present disputed questions with an available terminal medical-answer pool in both arms; terminal pool excludes gold
cohort_definitions.early_wrong: Disputed questions with a wrong unanimous terminal medical-answer round before the host round limit; excludes initially unanimous questions
cohort_definitions.statistics: Paired-question percentile bootstrap; equivalent multinomial resampling of per-question -1/0/+1 differences; 20000 resamples, statistical seed 20261003; exact two-sided McNemar
